statement: Angarak Yoga (Mars conjunct a lunar node -- Rahu or Ketu) is traditionally read as carrying impulsiveness and conflict-proneness, or, read more neutrally, intensified drive and courage that needs constructive channeling.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
